title: "gg_miami"
---
<br>
```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "> "
)
```

```{r setup}
library(saferGG)
```
<br>

### Datasets

The `file` and `chr` arguments require real GWAS-like data files (a results table and a chromosome size file), that are not shipped with the package. The examples below are therefore only given as \dontrun-like snippets, to be adapted to local files (see also `?gg_miami`).

```{r, eval = FALSE}
gg_miami(
    file = "C:/path/to/fisher.tsv", 
    chr = "C:/path/to/hg19_grch37p5_chr_size_cumul.txt", 
    top_y_column = "NEG_LOG10_P_VALUE_CARRIER_MODEL", 
    bottom_y_column = "AF"
)
```
<br>

### Arguments top_y_column and bottom_y_column

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Top part only (no bottom_y_column).
gg_miami(
    file = "path/to/results.tsv", 
    chr = "path/to/chr_size_cumul.txt", 
    top_y_column = "NEG_LOG10_P_VALUE_CARRIER_MODEL"
)
# Top and bottom parts.
gg_miami(
    file = "path/to/results.tsv", 
    chr = "path/to/chr_size_cumul.txt", 
    top_y_column = "NEG_LOG10_P_VALUE_CARRIER_MODEL", 
    bottom_y_column = "AF"
)
```
<br>

### Arguments x_lim and vgrid

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# x_lim accepts either "whole" (default) or a special character string,
# like "chr7:100000000-150000000" (single region), "chr7" (whole chromosome),
# or "chr7,chr1" (two chromosomes). vgrid is a single logical value that
# displays the chromosome separators.
gg_miami(
    file = "path/to/results.tsv", 
    chr = "path/to/chr_size_cumul.txt", 
    top_y_column = "NEG_LOG10_P_VALUE_CARRIER_MODEL", 
    x_lim = "chr7:100000000-150000000", 
    vgrid = TRUE
)
```
<br>

### Arguments color_column, dot_border_color, y_lim1, y_lim2, reverse1 and reverse2

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# color_column is the column used to alternate the dot colors per chromosome,
# y_lim1/y_lim2 the y-axis ranges of the top/bottom panels (2 numeric values,
# order matters for inverted axis) and reverse1/reverse2 single logical values
# that flip the y-axis of the top/bottom panels.
gg_miami(
    file = "path/to/results.tsv", 
    chr = "path/to/chr_size_cumul.txt", 
    top_y_column = "NEG_LOG10_P_VALUE_CARRIER_MODEL", 
    bottom_y_column = "AF", 
    color_column = "CHR", 
    dot_border_color = "gray50", 
    y_lim1 = c(0, 20), 
    y_lim2 = c(0, 1), 
    reverse1 = TRUE, 
    reverse2 = FALSE
)
```
<br>

### Arguments y_threshold1, y_threshold2, y_log1 and y_log2

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# y_threshold1/y_threshold2 are single numeric values (y-axis thresholds beyond
# which values are of interest) and y_log1/y_log2 single logical values for the
# log10 scale of the y-axis of the top/bottom panels.
gg_miami(
    file = "path/to/results.tsv", 
    chr = "path/to/chr_size_cumul.txt", 
    top_y_column = "NEG_LOG10_P_VALUE_CARRIER_MODEL", 
    bottom_y_column = "AF", 
    y_threshold1 = -base::log10(x = 5e-08), 
    y_log1 = TRUE, 
    y_log2 = TRUE
)
```
<br>

### Argument warn_print

```{r, eval = FALSE}
gg_miami(
    file = "path/to/results.tsv", 
    chr = "path/to/chr_size_cumul.txt", 
    top_y_column = "NEG_LOG10_P_VALUE_CARRIER_MODEL", 
    warn_print = TRUE
)
```
